China A-share shipping sector opened higher; Zhongyuan Haite surged nearly 8%, Dongfang Jiasheng and Sumec rose over 3%, and China Merchants Shipping, China Merchants Nanyou and COSCO Shipping Holdings also advanced.

At the open of China A-shares, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.13%, the Shenzhen Composite fell 0.82% and the ChiNext Index fell 1.46%. Lab-grown diamond and shipping stocks led gains; China shipbuilding-related names, PEEK materials and crude palm oil-linked stocks were the biggest decliners.
